dedupe_keys.name: arkansas permitted solid waste facility data

description: This database lists solid waste facilities permitted in Arkansas, such as landfills, transfer stations, composting and recovery facilities, and can be searched on the web or downloaded whole. It is published by the Arkansas Division of Environmental Quality, which permits and inspects these facilities. The search form filters by facility identifier (AFIN), permit number, facility or owner name, city, county and facility type, and results link to facility records; a zipped Microsoft Access copy of the underlying data can be downloaded, and a map shows active transfer stations and solid waste recovery facilities. Coverage is the whole state at facility level. The data are free; no licence is stated. Caveats: the download is in Access format, which needs conversion, field meanings must be inferred from the search page, and closed or historic sites may be incomplete. Simulation uses: locations and types of waste facilities for waste collection, transfer and disaster debris network models in Arkansas. Related records: the EPA Disaster Debris Recovery Tool (data-epa-disaster-debris-recovery-tool) gives a national list of landfills and recyclers, and the Texas active facility data (data-tceq-msw-facility-data-files) are a neighbouring state's equivalent.
